title: Motion Sensor Blind Spot Detector
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue bridge events (`hue:event`), Nest/Ecobee thermostat (`ecobee:thermostat`), door/leak/motion sensors.
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=zigbee2mqtt:device sensor_type=motion
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as triggers by sensor _time
| eventstats avg(triggers) as avg_triggers by sensor
| where avg_triggers>0 AND triggers=0
| sort sensor _time
description: Finds motion sensors that used to trigger normally but have gone completely quiet for the day, often because of batteries, dead zones, or placement changes.
value: A motion sensor that never fires is not just unhelpful - it creates false trust in dependent lights, alarms, or occupancy logic.
implementation: Capture motion events from all sensors; schedule daily and investigate sensors that unexpectedly record zero activity.
visualization: Daily grid of motion sensors with zero-trigger days highlighted.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which motion sensors used to see activity but suddenly went completely silent.
